dct_description_sm: Cadastral map showing land ownership in central Tokyo.

Cover title: Ō-Edo ezu. Wood block print. Presumably original map created in Kanei Period 1630 or 1631, reprinted in Tenpō Period (1831-1845). Oriented with north toward the upper right. Relief shown pictorially. Pictorial map. Cadastral map showing land ownership in central Tokyo. Includes distance chart. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
